findings.F-11: the reused long-loop leg's display oracle is stale against the emitted DISP schema (device emits 12 fields, that verifier parses 14); it belongs to the display-window leg, and because the profile's verdict ANDs both halves it also blocks this composition
findings.F-12: WITHDRAWN in the same session: 'the lane's dispatch stopped once the transport started' read a capture-regime property as a dispatch property. The qualification run measured the real reason (see F-13).
findings.F-13: the lane's coverage/overrun rows (DIAG,win_gap / DIAG,win_gap_overrun) are not Tier-A in CaptureLineTier.h, so flushCaptureBuffer sheds them silently at the timing-critical budget of 8 -- i.e. exactly while a track plays. The declared 'operationally reported' permitted-advance envelope therefore cannot be observed under transport until that tier entry exists (a separate decision: the authorization here was the lane's enablement, not an instrument change). Measured: one #CAP row reached the host across ~262 s of transport in the qualification run.
